products.title: Briefs Trial Pack - Flat Seams
products.body_html:
This listing is for the Find My Size WunderUndies Breifs Trial Pack with flat seams.

We have found that while kids love their WunderUndies, they are very particular about their sizing. Some like them looser and some like them tighter. So the Find My Size Trial Pack was invented! With this trial pack you will receive 2 pairs of WunderUndies briefs in 2 different sizes. This way you can find the size that suits your child the best. 

WunderUndies briefs are the ultimate solution for sensory-sensitive kiddos—or for any parent whose child hates to wear underwear. Designed with care, these briefs are crafted from incredibly soft, eco-friendly bamboo fabric that feels like a second skin. Say goodbye to irritation and discomfort—WunderUndies are elastic-free, featuring a fabric waistband that stays comfortably snug without pinching or slipping.

What makes these briefs truly special is their flat-seam construction, meticulously crafted with a flat lock machine. Waistbands and leg bands have their seams on the outside and are sewn flat, ensuring a smooth, irritation-free experience. Paired with a tagless design, these briefs are a game-changer for kids who struggle with traditional underwear.

Once your child tries WunderUndies, they’ll finally have underwear they love—and so will you.

Available in sizes 2T–12.

products.title: Kids Briefs - Flat Seams
products.body_html:
Say hello to our latest innovation in sensory-friendly comfort: WunderUndies briefs with flat seams. Thoughtfully designed to meet the needs of kids with sensory sensitivities, these briefs take our commitment to comfort and inclusion to the next level.

What sets these apart? Our new construction eliminates bulky inside seams altogether, ensuring a smooth, irritation-free fit. While our previous designs already prioritized softness and comfort, we’ve listened to feedback from parents and kids alike to create an option that feels like a second skin—perfect for those who need an extra touch of sensory ease.

Crafted from our signature bamboo fabric, WunderUndies are not only buttery-soft but also breathable and eco-friendly. They feature our same fun, gender-inclusive designs that kids love, making them a favorite for self-expression. Plus, the flat-seam design means no tags, no bumps, and no distractions—just pure comfort for play, rest, and everything in between.

At WunderUndies, we’re always striving to evolve, and this new flat seam style is a reflection of that growth. Whether your child is already a fan of our original WunderUndies or you’re discovering us for the first time, we’re confident these briefs will become a staple in their wardrobe.

Give your child the gift of ultimate comfort and confidence with WunderUndies Flat Seams Briefs. Because every kid deserves to feel good in their own skin—inside and out.
